import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;

    static class MatrixStruct {
        int rowCount, colCount;
        long[] vals;

        MatrixStruct(int r, int c) {
            this.rowCount = r;
            this.colCount = c;
            this.vals = new long[r * c];
        }

        long index(int r, int c) {
            return vals[r * colCount + c];
        }

        long index(int r, int c, boolean get) {
            return vals[r * colCount + c];
        }

        void setIndex(int r, int c, long value) {
            vals[r * colCount + c] = value;
        }

        MatrixStruct add(MatrixStruct m) {
            assert this.rowCount == m.rowCount && this.colCount == m.colCount;
            for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; ++i) {
                this.vals[i] = (this.vals[i] + m.vals[i]) % mod;
            }
            return this;
        }

        MatrixStruct subtract(MatrixStruct m) {
            assert this.rowCount == m.rowCount && this.colCount == m.colCount;
            for (int i = 0; i < vals.length; ++i) {
                this.vals[i] = (this.vals[i] - m.vals[i] + mod) % mod;
            }
            return this;
        }

        MatrixStruct multiply(MatrixStruct m) {
            assert this.colCount == m.rowCount;
            MatrixStruct result = new MatrixStruct(this.rowCount, m.colCount);
            for (int i = 0; i < this.rowCount; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m.colCount; ++j) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < this.colCount; ++k) {
                        sum += this.index(i, k) * m.index(k, j);
                    }
                    result.setIndex(i, j, sum % mod);
                }
            }
            this.rowCount = result.rowCount;
            this.colCount = result.colCount;
            this.vals = result.vals;
            return this;
        }

        static MatrixStruct identity(int n) {
            MatrixStruct res = new MatrixStruct(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                res.setIndex(i, i, 1);
            }
            return res;
        }

        static MatrixStruct power(MatrixStruct a, int n) {
            assert a.rowCount == a.colCount;
            MatrixStruct res = identity(a.rowCount);
            MatrixStruct base = new MatrixStruct(a.rowCount, a.colCount);
            base.vals = a.vals.clone();
            int power = n;
            while (power > 0) {
                if ((power & 1) == 1) {
                    res.multiply(base);
                }
                base.multiply(base);
                power >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static List<MatrixStruct> matrices = new ArrayList<>();

    static long compute(int i, int k) {
        return MatrixStruct.power(matrices.get(i + k), k - i)
                .multiply(MatrixStruct.power(matrices.get(i), i))
                .index(0, 0);
    }

    static long main_process(long n, long k) {
        long count = 0, tmp = n;
        while (tmp != 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            count++;
        }
        List<MatrixStruct> b = new ArrayList<>();
        List<MatrixStruct> c = new ArrayList<>();
        List<MatrixStruct> d = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= count + 4; ++i) {
            b.add(new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
            c.add(new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            d.add(new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
        }

        b.set(0, new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
        c.set(0, new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (int)k; ++i) {
            matrices.add(new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (int)k; ++i) {
            MatrixStruct m = matrices.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                m.setIndex(0, j, 1);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * (int)k - 1; ++j) {
                m.setIndex(j + 1, j, 1);
            }
            m.setIndex(2 * (int)k, 0, 1);
            m.setIndex(2 * (int)k, 2 * (int)k, 1);
        }

        // Initialize b[0], c[0], b[1], c[1]
        b.set(0, matrices.get(k - 1));
        c.set(0, MatrixStruct.power(b.get(0), k - 1));
        b.set(1, new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
        b.get(1).vals = compute(k - 1, (int)k);
        c.set(1, MatrixStruct.power(b.get(1), k - 1));

        MatrixStruct s = MatrixStruct.identity(2 * (int)k + 1);
        for (int j = 2; j <= count + 1; ++j) {
            b.set(j, new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1));
            b.get(j).vals = compute(k - j % (int)k, (int)k);
            s.multiply(c.get(j - 1));
            b.get(j).multiply(s);
            c.set(j, MatrixStruct.power(b.get(j), k - 1));
        }

        int idx = 1;
        int rem = (int) (n % k);
        n -= rem;
        int q = 0;
        long tmp2 = n;
        if (tmp2 != 0) {
            while (tmp2 % k == 0) {
                ++q;
                tmp2 /= k;
            }
        }
        q = (int) (k - q % k) % (int)k;

        MatrixStruct ans = MatrixStruct.identity(2 * (int)k + 1);
        ans.multiply(MatrixStruct.power(matrices.get(q), rem));
        ans.multiply(MatrixStruct.power(matrices.get(q + (int)k), Math.max(rem - q, 0)));

        n /= k;
        if (n == 0) {
            long val = (ans.index(2 * (int)k, 0) + ans.index(0, 0)) % mod;
            return val;
        }
        --n;
        while (n > 0) {
            int t = (int) (n % k);
            if (t != 0) {
                ans.multiply(MatrixStruct.power(b.get(idx), t));
            }
            n /= k;
            ++idx;
        }
        ans.multiply(b.get(1));
        long result = (ans.index(2 * (int)k, 0) + ans.index(0, 0)) % mod;
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        int maxIndex = (int) (2 * k);
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxIndex; ++i) {
            MatrixStruct m = new MatrixStruct(2 * (int)k + 1, 2 * (int)k + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                m.setIndex(0, j, 1);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * (int)k - 1; ++j) {
                m.setIndex(j + 1, j, 1);
            }
            m.setIndex(2 * (int)k, 0, 1);
            m.setIndex(2 * (int)k, 2 * (int)k, 1);
            matrices.add(i, m);
        }

        System.out.println(main_process(n, k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
